data.name: Layer1GapNarrativeLabel
data.value: Layer 1 Gap Narrative: Identify the highest-priority governance gaps in the Training layer. For each gap, describe what decisions are being made without governance and the first recommended governance action.

data.name: Layer2GapNarrativeLabel
data.value: Layer 2 Gap Narrative: Identify the highest-priority governance gaps in the Fine-Tuning layer. For each gap, describe what decisions are being made without governance and the first recommended governance action.

data.name: Layer3GapNarrativeLabel
data.value: Layer 3 Gap Narrative: Identify the highest-priority governance gaps in the Deployment layer. For each gap, describe what decisions are being made without governance and the first recommended governance action.

data.name: Domain1_1_Level0
data.value: Does any formal review process exist for training data selection?

data.name: Domain1_1_Level1
data.value: Is there documented awareness within the governance function that dataset curation decisions are governance decisions?

data.name: Domain1_1_Level2
data.value: Does a formal review process exist for dataset curation that includes governance function involvement?

data.name: Domain1_1_Level3
data.value: Does the formal process include all of the following: named review authority, documented inclusion and exclusion criteria, consent basis documentation, representational scope assessment, and a pre-training gate?

data.name: Domain1_2_Level0
data.value: Does the governance function have any involvement in category boundary decisions before they are encoded?

data.name: Domain1_2_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have awareness that category design is a governance decision, even without a formal process for influencing it?

data.name: Domain1_2_Level2
data.value: Does a formal review process exist for category design decisions that includes governance function involvement before categories are encoded?

data.name: Domain1_2_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a category inventory produced before training, named authority for approving contested categories, documented rationale, and a defined process for challenging boundaries?

data.name: Domain1_3_Level0
data.value: Does any documented governance review exist for optimization objectives before training begins?

data.name: Domain1_3_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have visibility into training architecture decisions even without formal authority over them?

data.name: Domain1_3_Level2
data.value: Does a formal review process exist for optimization objectives that includes governance sign-off before training begins?

data.name: Domain1_3_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a training objective authorization document, named authority for sign-off, defined evaluation criteria, and authority to halt or restart training?

data.name: Domain1_4_Level0
data.value: Does a named authority or formal process exist for assessing representational adequacy before training?

data.name: Domain1_4_Level1
data.value: Is representational adequacy considered informally during training data selection, even without a structured process?

data.name: Domain1_4_Level2
data.value: Does a structured representational review process exist that assesses the training corpus against defined population coverage criteria before training proceeds?

data.name: Domain1_4_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a named review authority with power to halt training, defined standards for adequate representation, a documented remediation process, and a representational review report?

data.name: Domain2_1_Level0
data.value: Does the governance function have any involvement in fine-tuning data selection decisions?

data.name: Domain2_1_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have awareness that proprietary data selection for fine-tuning is a governance decision?

data.name: Domain2_1_Level2
data.value: Does a formal review process exist for fine-tuning data selection that includes governance function involvement?

data.name: Domain2_1_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a fine-tuning data record for each dataset, documented consent basis, named review authority, elevated review for employee/customer data, and a pre-fine-tuning gate?

data.name: Domain2_2_Level0
data.value: Are fine-tuning objectives subject to any governance function involvement or review before fine-tuning begins?

data.name: Domain2_2_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have visibility into fine-tuning objectives even without formal authority over them?

data.name: Domain2_2_Level2
data.value: Does a formal review process exist for fine-tuning objectives that requires governance sign-off before fine-tuning begins?

data.name: Domain2_2_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a fine-tuning objective authorization document, named sign-off authority, documented assessment of assumptions, defined evaluation criteria, and a process for future audit?

data.name: Domain2_3_Level0
data.value: Does any governance-specific record exist for customization decisions, separate from general system architecture documentation?

data.name: Domain2_3_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have awareness that customization scope decisions are governance decisions, even without a formal review process?

data.name: Domain2_3_Level2
data.value: Does a formal process exist for reviewing and documenting customization decisions before deployment?

data.name: Domain2_3_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a customization scope boundary document, named authority for authorizing decisions, a defined process for reviewing relaxations, and handoff to deployment governance?

data.name: Domain2_4_Level0
data.value: Is RAG configuration subject to any governance review?

data.name: Domain2_4_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have awareness that RAG configuration is a governance decision?

data.name: Domain2_4_Level2
data.value: Does a formal review process exist for RAG corpus authorization and configuration changes?

data.name: Domain2_4_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a RAG corpus governance log, named authority, a defined review cycle, a process for removing outdated content, and an evaluation process for output quality?

data.name: Domain3_1_Level0
data.value: Does the governance function have any formal involvement in vendor selection decisions?

data.name: Domain3_1_Level1
data.value: Does the governance function have informal input into vendor selection even without a formal process or defined criteria?

data.name: Domain3_1_Level2
data.value: Does a formal governance review process exist for vendor selection that includes governance function involvement and defined governance criteria?

data.name: Domain3_1_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a vendor governance scorecard, required disclosures, governance function sign-off, a vendor disclosure file, and defined review at renewal?

data.name: Domain3_2_Level0
data.value: Does a formal process exist for authorizing use cases before deployment?

data.name: Domain3_2_Level1
data.value: Does informal consideration of use case appropriateness occur before deployment even without a structured authorization process?

data.name: Domain3_2_Level2
data.value: Does a formal use case authorization process exist that requires governance review before a use case goes into production?

data.name: Domain3_2_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a use case authorization register, named authority, defined criteria, a list of prohibited use cases, and a process for reviewing use case creep?

data.name: Domain3_3_Level0
data.value: Does a formal governance review of deployment scope exist that covers access, action authority, and human oversight requirements?

data.name: Domain3_3_Level1
data.value: Does informal consideration of deployment scope occur even without a formal process or documented scope definition?

data.name: Domain3_3_Level2
data.value: Does a formal process exist for defining and reviewing deployment scope before a system goes into production?

data.name: Domain3_3_Level3
data.value: Does the process include all of the following: a deployment scope document, named authority, defined human review requirements, a process for authorizing scope changes, and a monitoring review process?

data.name: Domain3_4_Level0
data.value: Is there a pre-defined accountability structure in place to handle AI failures before they occur?

data.name: Domain3_4_Level1
data.value: Does informal understanding of accountability exist within the governance function even without documented assignments?

data.name: Domain3_4_Level2
data.value: Does a documented accountability structure exist that defines governance function versus technical function responsibility before a failure occurs?

data.name: Domain3_4_Level3
data.value: Does the structure include all of the following: named accountability assignments, a documented vendor versus organization boundary, a defined remediation process, a failure escalation protocol, and a process for learning from decisions?
